title: 5 things I use Claude for every day while preparing for a 30 LPA job

vo.voice: Utkarsh - Viral UGC Content Creator (ElevenLabs voice 0S6xG2aDSxyTDcYrV1oo, eleven_multilingual_v2)
segments: Stop using Claude like Google. Here are five things I use it for every day, while preparing for a thirty L P A job.
Number one. It plans my day. My sixteen-week plan becomes today's to-do list, right inside Notion.
Number two. Hints, not answers. Stuck on a DSA problem? I ask for one hint, then I try again.
Number three. It explains every concept using my own project, the chat app I'm building.
Number four. It reviews my code like a senior developer, before any interviewer sees it.
Number five. It checks on me at 2 AM, and tells me exactly what I haven't finished.
It doesn't do the work for me. It makes sure I do it.
Comment the word prompts, and I'll send you all five.
Day five: same prompt, two models.
